answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Peer review record with journal editor assignment chain is the check: reviews completed for one journal over years. A farm faking 498 aliases needs 498 separate review histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the vertex signal is public, the atlas check is automatic, and 498 aliases cost 498 times what one real agent costs, with the willow trail open to all.
